raw_segments.text: They came down the steps from Leahy's terrace prudently, fronsomer, and down the shelving
shore flabbily their splayed feet sinking in the silted sand, like me like algae coming
Number one swung lurdily her midwife's bag, the other's gamp poked in the beach, from
the liberties out for the day.
Mrs. Florence MacCabe, relict of the late Pack MacCabe, deeply lamented of Bride Street.
One of her sisterhood lugged me squealing into life, creation from nothing.
What is she in the bag?
A misbirth with a trailing naval cord hushed in ruddy wool.
The cords of all link back, strand entwining cable of all flesh.
That is why mystic monks, will you be as gods, gaze in your omphilos?
Hello, kench here, put me on to Edenville.
